items.title: Two base-change stable properties realised by approximations can be realised simultaneously
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes and two properties of morphisms stable under base change, if each property is realised by some finite type approximation of the morphism over a base of finite type over Z, then both properties are realised by a single such approximation. The proof combines the two approximating diagrams by forming a common refinement of their bases and descending both properties to it, using base-change stability to keep the properties when the base is enlarged. Producing one approximation carrying both properties is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10036-10072.
